message.content: {"output_action": "CREATE", "skill_draft": {"name": "enforce_modality_tool_match", "description": "When interpreting medical imaging, verify that the image modality matches the capabilities of available tools before generating an analysis.", "applicable_conditions": "Tasks involving medical imaging interpretation where specific diagnostic tools are restricted to certain modalities (e.g., X-ray vs. CT vs. MRI).", "branch": "task_level", "tool_name": null, "task_category": ["medical_imaging_interpretation"], "required_tools": ["chest_xray_classifier", "chest_xray_report_generator"], "risk_level": "high", "core_action": "If the input is a medical image: (1) Identify the imaging modality (e.g., CXR, CT, MRI); (2) Check if available tools support this specific modality; (3) If tools are limited to a different modality (e.g., only CXR tools available for a CT scan), do NOT attempt to analyze the image directly or hallucinate findings.
